issue.title: test_done_row_dismissed_without_signal_and_stays_hidden loses its full-history fixture row under parallel tests
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1se.3 note #1, triaged by sase-1se.land on 2026-11-12.

In recorded ToolRun 3ef55fe2698bda9fc9d5baea5015ebaf (sase tool run check,
the governed test-scoped lane internally chose the full parallel suite),
tests/ace/tui/test_agents_tab_x_row_lifecycle_e2e.py::test_done_row_dismissed_without_signal_and_stays_hidden
failed on gw0 at line 274, before dismissal:

    assert identity in await disk_rows(full_history=True)
    AssertionError: assert (<AgentType.RUNNING: 'run'>, '~', '20260924143001') in set()

The app roster had already reached the expected DONE/STARTING pair, but the
full-history disk loader returned no identities. The same tree's isolated
serial rerun, ToolRun 08449bb057071dbd1e4a8e664506642d, passed 1/1 in 11.71s.
Both retained logs were read during this triage. Observed fail rate is one
parallel failure followed by one serial pass; wider rate and root cause are
unknown. The parallel run reported 60,871 passed, 17 skipped and two failures;
the other failure was preprocessing environment isolation, since fixed by
cc236079f4, and is not part of this task.

Investigate the row loader/index/fixture synchronization and state isolation;
add a deterministic regression for the established cause rather than weakening
the assertion or increasing delays blindly. The auto-restart epic modified
classifier and healer paths, not this completed-row loader path. All-status
same-type and all-type searches and last-week sweeps found no duplicate.
sase-1sf is a different pager clipboard node. Active scanner epic sase-zu/.4
and global-state epic sase-j7/.4 were inspected, but this evidence does not
establish that either caused this flake. Size large because the root cause
needs investigation, rather than a known focused edit.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1se.3 proposed this independently observed fail/pass flake; landing review verified both retained runs and found no duplicate or established active-epic cause.

payload.description: The failing assertion uses the full-history loader this epic introduced; causality remains unproven.

evidence.note: Independent occurrence from epic sase-1sb (proposed by phase sase-1sb.5 note #1, triaged by sase-1sb.land): ToolRun 9fc932a5c1882d437f428b27d2054f6d (sase tool run check, parallel pytest lease 6, 2026-11-11, tree at sase-1sb.5's lock fix) failed this test at tests/ace/tui/test_agents_tab_x_row_lifecycle_e2e.py:274 with the identical signature 'assert (<AgentType.RUNNING: run>, ~, 20260924143001) in set()' (stdout.log line 986); the phase agent's isolated rerun passed. sase-1sb.5 touched only src/sase/ace/patch/locking.py and its tests, so this is a second unrelated-diff occurrence of the same full-history disk-loader race under parallel load.

Independent occurrence from epic sase-1sd (proposed by phase sase-1sd.7 note #3, triaged by sase-1sd.land). ToolRun 43b7f9c4342bc7a701d95d907eef1288 (sase tool run check, base c77ff7e8f7 plus the 1sd.7 attachments diff, load1 ~30) failed a sibling node in the same file: test_failed_row_dismiss_terminates_live_runner_and_stays_hidden at tests/ace/tui/test_agents_tab_x_row_lifecycle_e2e.py:226. The failure was 'assert identity in await disk_rows(full_history=True)' with AssertionError 'assert (<AgentType.RUNNING: run>, ~, 20260924142001) in set()' (owner log /home/bryan/.sase/procs/logs/jf29ppx6tqhj.log line 940). That is the same empty full-history disk-loader signature on a different node. The phase agent's isolated reruns passed on the clean base and on the diff. The 1sd.7 diff touched only attachments/sidecar files. The fix should cover both nodes, since they share the disk_rows(full_history=True) fixture path.
